style: Wolf dungeon: weathered silver, ivory fangs, grey fur and moonstones

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: finished square fantasy RPG inventory icon for DiceFree's Moonfang Signet, a rare wolf-dungeon ring. Create ONE isolated equipment item, fully inside a square canvas with generous but compact 8% padding, genuinely transparent background, no frame, no text, no watermark. Hand-painted high-fantasy game icon with crisp chunky silhouette and rich sculpted material detail, readable at 48 pixels. Show a substantial weathered silver signet ring in three-quarter view: its entire face is an unmistakable snarling WOLF HEAD with tall pointed ears, long angular muzzle, pronounced ivory canine fangs, icy cyan moonstone eyes and a single small blue moonstone in the forehead. Intertwined claw engravings around the silver band, blackened crevices, bright cool silver edge highlights and restrained warm bronze binding details. Wolf head is large and dominant; the circular band is clearly visible beneath it, so it still reads as a wearable ring. Cool moonlit silver/ivory/navy palette with blue highlights, tactile stylized metal, polished professional RPG item art. This wolf-head ring establishes the cohesive visual style for a six-item wolf equipment set.

Fur, leather and metal must read as separate tactile materials. Broad strong shoulders, no arms, no helmet, no character, no long cloak. Blue moonstone and silver/ivory palette.
